topic: Mindset: Why billing by project value beats hourly rates every time as a freelancer

post.topic: Mindset: Why billing by project value beats hourly rates every time as a freelancer
post.linkedin_text:
Hourly rates punish you for getting faster and better at your job.

When I first started freelancing, tracking every billable minute felt safe. But it capped my income and created friction with clients every time a task took longer than expected.

Moving to value-based pricing changed everything.

• Focus shifts from time spent to problem solved
• Clients care about results, not hours logged
• Your efficiency finally becomes your financial advantage

It takes practice to estimate the real business value of a web app or mobile feature. But once you stop trading hours for dollars, your freelance business scales differently.

How do you currently price your freelance development projects?

#FreelanceDeveloper #WebDevelopment #TechCareers #SoftwareEngineering

slides.title: Why Hourly Rates Are *Costing* You Money
slides.body: The mindset shift every freelance developer needs to make.

slides.title: The Speed Penalty
slides.body: When you charge hourly, getting faster and writing better code directly reduces your paycheck. That is the wrong incentive.

slides.title: Sell Outcomes, Not Time
slides.body: Clients do not care about the hours. They care about the deployed app, the fixed bug, or the revenue your feature generates.

slides.title: Charge For Expertise
slides.body: Pricing by project value rewards your years of experience instead of your typing speed. It is fairer for both sides.
